title: Scream 8 might have already found its directors, as American Mary horror helmers respond to rumours - NewsBreak
text:
By Megan Garside ,
16 hours ago
Scream 8 might have already found its directors, as filmmaking duo and twins Jen and Sylvia Soska respond to rumours.
On August 8, one horror fan took to Twitter, writing, "Spyglass is reportedly closing negotiations with the Soska Sisters (Jen and Sylvia) to take over directing the next installment in the Scream horror franchise. The 'Twisted Twins' are said to have met secretly with studio executives this week." Then, three days later, the Soska Sisters replied with the eyes emoji. Is this a suggestion they know something we don't?
Paramount confirmed that Scream 8 had entered development earlier this year , with Poker Face writers Lilla and Nora Zuckerman attached to pen the script. However, with original Scream writer and Scream 7 director Kevin Williamson not expected to return, the director's chair was left open. Neither Paramount nor Spyglass have addressed the rumours, but it sure does seem like fans want the Soska Sisters to take the lead.
"If this happens, this will be the first time in years I'm excited for a Scream sequel!" replied one Twitter user , and another added , "If you two are part of it then I know it will be worth seeing." The Soska Sisters are best known for their gory horror features, including the much-loved 2013 movie American Mary.
The 30-year-old franchise has seen its fair share of directors, from creator Wes Craven to Ready or Not duo Tyler Gillett and Matt Bettinelli-Olpin. No matter who takes on Scream 8, they have a huge act to follow. Scream 7 exceeded all expectations earlier this year, becoming the most successful movie in the franchise. The sequel earned over $220 million worldwide during its theatrical run.
It is not clear where Scream 8 will take the franchise. The last movie relied heavily on legacy characters. But the upcoming sequel could well introduce a new group of victims just like Scream 5 did, or it could focus on Scream 7's final girl and Sidney Prescott's daughter, Tatum Evans. When Ghostface is involved, anything is possible.
Scream 8 does not yet have a release date. For more, check out our ranking of the best Scream movies and keep up with upcoming horror movies heading your way.
